rows.desc: <color=#d14e0d>Clearing unlocks the outpost: Light Cannon Outpost</color>. Defeat all enemy ships to win.
<color=#d14e0d>Clearing unlocks the outpost: Rapid-Fire Cannon Outpost</color>. Defeat all enemy ships to win.

<color=#d14e0d>Clearing unlocks the outpost: Fortress Outpost</color>. Defeat all enemy ships to win.
Stage tip: if you can't quickly destroy fast-moving enemies, try blocking their advance with a Fortress Outpost.
<color=#d14e0d>Clearing unlocks the outpost: Mortar Outpost</color>. Defeat all enemy ships to win.

Stage tip: Warehouse Outposts produce lots of battle energy at intervals; use them well to gather many resources in a short time.
Stage tip: the Doom Cannon Outpost is the strongest AoE outpost. It's expensive, but even one can turn the tide, and a few can easily wipe out a whole enemy fleet
Stage tip: if Fortress Outposts can't stop the enemy's massed charge, try Advanced Fortress Outposts
Stage tip: while early route pressure is light, quickly upgrade production from Light Cannon to Warehouse Outposts, build up battle energy, and dominate with Doom Cannons.
<color=#d14e0d>Clearing unlocks the outpost: Shock Cannon Outpost</color>. Defeat all enemy ships to win.
Stage tip: the Shock Cannon Outpost is the strongest single-target outpost, but very expensive, so building an economic lead fast is key to clearing this stage.
Stage tip: watch out for enemy fleets raiding a single route.
Stage tip: resources cap at 30 units in this stage. Place outposts promptly to avoid waste, Captain.
Stage tip: resources cap at 90 units in this stage. Place outposts promptly to avoid waste, Captain.
Stage tip: watch the enemy fleet's strategy; they may have a "surprise" for you late on.
Stage tip: don't be intimidated by the endless enemy assault; staying calm is the key to victory.

rows.name: Luffy
rows.desc: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates, user of the Gum-Gum Fruit. His elastic body makes physical attacks weak against him. Deploying characters with elemental damage is the best way to beat him.

rows.name: Zoro
rows.desc: Swordsman of the Straw Hat Pirates, unstoppable with his Three-Sword Style. Every enemy his blades point at crumbles. A true swordsman, strong in attack and defense with no weakness! There are no tricks to beating him. Face him head-on, man to man!

rows.name: Nami
rows.desc: Navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates, who controls the weather freely with her Clima-Tact. When fighting her, keeping an eye on the sky is what matters most.

rows.name: Usopp
rows.desc: Sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates, a genius who uses all kinds of ammo to deal different elemental damage and excels at area attacks. Fragile characters are easily killed by his area damage.

rows.name: Sanji
rows.desc: Cook of the Straw Hat Pirates, a top-speed kick fighter whose powerful legs can stun any enemy. Front-line fighters with high HP and physical resistance are the best choice against him.

rows.name: Chopper
rows.desc: Doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates, a reindeer who ate the Human-Human Fruit. He changes form freely to suit the battle and is an excellent healer. Getting dragged into a war of attrition greatly raises your odds of losing, so a quick victory is key.

rows.name: Robin
rows.desc: Archaeologist of the Straw Hat Pirates. A survivor of Ohara, she had a bounty of 10 million on her head at just 8 years old. User of the Flower-Flower Fruit, she can make any part of her body bloom like a flower on anything solid within sight to attack or for other uses.

rows.name: Franky
rows.desc: Shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates, a cyborg who only modified his front because he did it himself. Both arms hide powerful weapons, and his Star Shield makes him strong in attack and defense.

rows.name: Brook
rows.desc: Musician of the Straw Hat Pirates, user of the Revive-Revive Fruit. Being nothing but bones makes him amazingly fast. With his unique swordplay, enemies often fall to his blade before they even see him.

rows.name: Buggy
rows.desc: Captain of the Buggy Pirates, user of the Chop-Chop Fruit. Anyone hit by his throwing knives suffers Bleed. His signature area attack, the Buggy Ball, also burns and stuns.

rows.name: Smoker
rows.desc: Marine Captain and user of the Smoke-Smoke Fruit. A man who hates pirates with a passion, with extremely strong single-target damage skills. Only healers and a strong front line can withstand his attacks!

rows.name: Tashigi
rows.desc: A Marine swordswoman whose superb swordsmanship belies her cute looks. Her powerful all-target damage skills can easily kill fragile characters.

rows.name: Mr.1
rows.desc: A Baroque Works agent who ate the Dice-Dice Fruit. He can slash with any part of his body, and his hard body gives him strong defense.

rows.name: Mr.2
rows.desc: A Baroque Works agent with a man's body and a maiden's heart. He excels at Okama Kenpo kicks, and his swan shoes make his kicks even more destructive.

rows.name: Mr.3
rows.desc: A Baroque Works agent who ate the Melting Fruit. The wax he makes is harder than steel, and anyone bound by his candle wax is greatly slowed.

rows.name: Bellamy
rows.desc: Captain of the Bellamy Pirates, user of the Spring Fruit. He can turn any part of his body into springs. His high-speed charge after compressing them easily stuns opponents and deals heavy damage.

rows.name: Jabra
rows.desc: A CP9 member who ate the Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Wolf, with a strong body and quick speed. He often shows openings on purpose to lower enemies' guard, then strikes by surprise.

rows.name: Kalifa
rows.desc: CP9's only female member, cold as an assassin yet a bit of a natural airhead. Her catchphrase is "That's sexual harassment". She ate the Bubble-Bubble Fruit and became a soap woman, weakening any enemy touched by her bubbles.

rows.name: Kaku
rows.desc: A CP9 member, a giraffe man who ate the Ox-Ox Fruit, Model: Giraffe. His neck and limbs are hugely destructive; he can wield swords in both hands and still use "Rankyaku". His skill "Amanedachi", unleashed by spinning at high speed on one hand, is extremely destructive!

rows.name: Rob Lucci
rows.desc: A senior World Government CP9 agent who ate the Zoan Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Leopard. The strongest member in CP9's 800-year history.

rows.name: Hogback
rows.desc: One of the Three Mysterious Men under Warlord Gecko Moria. A genius surgeon who once saved many patients with miraculous operations and earned the fame and status a doctor deserves. But the death of his goddess Cindry changed him; he became obsessed with the forbidden art of reviving the dead, and was eventually found and recruited by Moria.

rows.name: Perona
rows.desc: One of the Three Mysterious Men under Warlord Gecko Moria, and commander of the Animal Zombies and Surprise Zombies. A Paramecia user of the Hollow-Hollow Fruit, with the power to instantly crush an enemy's will to fight.

rows.name: Crocodile
rows.desc: One of the Seven Warlords, user of the Sand-Sand Fruit, who controls sand freely and can turn himself into sand. In sand form, Crocodile is highly resistant to physical damage, and his wind-element skills deal tons of damage.

rows.name: Enel
rows.desc: User of the Rumble-Rumble Fruit who calls himself God. He wields powerful lightning attacks, and ordinary fighters are reduced to charcoal before him. Luffy resists Enel's lightning damage well, and leaving fragile characters out greatly improves your odds of beating him.

rows.name: Aokiji
rows.desc: A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Ice-Ice Fruit, with the power to freeze anything. A mighty fighter with no weakness. There are no tricks to beating him; you just have to be stronger!

rows.name: Garp
rows.desc: A legendary Marine Vice Admiral, the man who drove Pirate King Roger to the brink. No defense holds up against his Haki-clad fists. He's also extremely carefree and may suddenly fall asleep mid-battle, but don't underestimate his strength because of it!

rows.name: Gecko Moria
rows.desc: A shadow-manipulating Devil Fruit user and ruler of Thriller Bark! One of the Seven Warlords, said to have once been a match for Kaido of the "Four Emperors".

rows.name: Bartholomew Kuma
rows.desc: One of the Seven Warlords, user of the Paw Pad Fruit. The paw pads on his palms can knock away anything they touch, and the air bombs he compresses between his palms are devastating, especially against characters standing in a row.

rows.name: Kizaru
rows.desc: A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Glint-Glint Fruit. The Marines' strongest force, yet very laid-back, he excels at kicks and swordplay. Be ready for a Speed-of-Light Kick before you challenge him!

rows.name: Portgas D. Ace
rows.desc: Second division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates and user of the Flame-Flame Fruit. A powerful fighter who controls fire freely and excels at area attacks, he can easily kill several characters at once.

rows.name: Akainu
rows.desc: A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Magma Fruit. Stern and upright, he upholds Absolute Justice and won't tolerate the slightest trace of "evil". He can turn his body into searing magma with tremendous power; his Great Eruption can instantly evaporate ice dozens of times bigger than a giant.

rows.name: Mihawk
rows.desc: The world's greatest swordsman. His black blade can cut any enemy to pieces, and sturdy front-line fighters are fragile in Mihawk's eyes. Healers can slow Mihawk's assault; try not to line your characters up in one column.

rows.name: Luffy
rows.place: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates, user of the Gum-Gum Fruit. His elastic body makes physical attacks weak against him. Deploying characters with elemental damage is the best way to beat him.

rows.name: Zoro
rows.place: Swordsman of the Straw Hat Pirates, unstoppable with his Three-Sword Style. Every enemy his blades point at crumbles. A true swordsman, strong in attack and defense with no weakness! There are no tricks to beating him. Face him head-on, man to man!

rows.name: Nami
rows.place: Navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates, who controls the weather freely with her Clima-Tact. When fighting her, keeping an eye on the sky is what matters most.

rows.name: Usopp
rows.place: Sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates, a genius who uses all kinds of ammo to deal different elemental damage and excels at area attacks. Fragile characters are easily killed by his area damage.

rows.name: Sanji
rows.place: Cook of the Straw Hat Pirates, a top-speed kick fighter whose powerful legs can stun any enemy. Front-line fighters with high HP and physical resistance are the best choice against him.

rows.name: Chopper
rows.place: Doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates, a reindeer who ate the Human-Human Fruit. He changes form freely to suit the battle and is an excellent healer. Getting dragged into a war of attrition greatly raises your odds of losing, so a quick victory is key.

rows.name: Franky
rows.place: Shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates, a cyborg who only modified his front because he did it himself. Both arms hide powerful weapons, and his Star Shield makes him strong in attack and defense.

rows.name: Buggy
rows.place: Captain of the Buggy Pirates, user of the Chop-Chop Fruit. Anyone hit by his throwing knives suffers Bleed. His signature area attack, the Buggy Ball, also burns and stuns.

rows.name: Smoker
rows.place: Marine Captain and user of the Smoke-Smoke Fruit. A man who hates pirates with a passion, with extremely strong single-target damage skills. Only healers and a strong front line can withstand his attacks!

rows.name: Tashigi
rows.place: A Marine swordswoman whose superb swordsmanship belies her cute looks. Her powerful all-target damage skills can easily kill fragile characters.

rows.name: Mr.1
rows.place: A Baroque Works agent who ate the Dice-Dice Fruit. He can slash with any part of his body, and his hard body gives him strong defense.

rows.name: Mr.2
rows.place: A Baroque Works agent with a man's body and a maiden's heart. He excels at Okama Kenpo kicks, and his swan shoes make his kicks even more destructive.

rows.name: Mr.3
rows.place: A Baroque Works agent who ate the Melting Fruit. The wax he makes is harder than steel, and anyone bound by his candle wax is greatly slowed.

rows.name: Bellamy
rows.place: Captain of the Bellamy Pirates, user of the Spring Fruit. He can turn any part of his body into springs. His high-speed charge after compressing them easily stuns opponents and deals heavy damage.

rows.name: Brook
rows.place: Musician of the Straw Hat Pirates, user of the Revive-Revive Fruit. Being nothing but bones makes him amazingly fast. With his unique swordplay, enemies often fall to his blade before they even see him.

rows.name: Jabra
rows.place: A CP9 member who ate the Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Wolf, with a strong body and quick speed. He often shows openings on purpose to lower enemies' guard, then strikes by surprise.

rows.name: Kalifa
rows.place: CP9's only female member, cold as an assassin yet a bit of a natural airhead. Her catchphrase is "That's sexual harassment". She ate the Bubble-Bubble Fruit and became a soap woman, weakening any enemy touched by her bubbles.

rows.name: Kaku
rows.place: A CP9 member, a giraffe man who ate the Ox-Ox Fruit, Model: Giraffe. His neck and limbs are hugely destructive; he can wield swords in both hands and still use "Rankyaku". His skill "Amanedachi", unleashed by spinning at high speed on one hand, is extremely destructive!

rows.name: Robin
rows.place: Archaeologist of the Straw Hat Pirates. A survivor of Ohara, she had a bounty of 10 million on her head at just 8 years old. User of the Flower-Flower Fruit, she can make any part of her body bloom like a flower on anything solid within sight to attack or for other uses.

rows.name: Hogback
rows.place: One of the Three Mysterious Men under Warlord Gecko Moria. A genius surgeon who once saved many patients with miraculous operations and earned the fame and status a doctor deserves. But the death of his goddess Cindry changed him; he became obsessed with the forbidden art of reviving the dead, and was eventually found and recruited by Moria.

rows.name: Perona
rows.place: One of the Three Mysterious Men under Warlord Gecko Moria, and commander of the Animal Zombies and Surprise Zombies. A Paramecia user of the Hollow-Hollow Fruit, with the power to instantly crush an enemy's will to fight.

rows.name: Crocodile
rows.place: One of the Seven Warlords, user of the Sand-Sand Fruit, who controls sand freely and can turn himself into sand. In sand form, Crocodile is highly resistant to physical damage, and his wind-element skills deal tons of damage.

rows.name: Aokiji
rows.place: A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Ice-Ice Fruit, with the power to freeze anything. A mighty fighter with no weakness. There are no tricks to beating him; you just have to be stronger!

rows.name: Mihawk
rows.place: The world's greatest swordsman. His black blade can cut any enemy to pieces, and sturdy front-line fighters are fragile in Mihawk's eyes. Healers can slow Mihawk's assault; try not to line your characters up in one column.

rows.name: Enel
rows.place: User of the Rumble-Rumble Fruit who calls himself God. He wields powerful lightning attacks, and ordinary fighters are reduced to charcoal before him. Luffy resists Enel's lightning damage well, and leaving fragile characters out greatly improves your odds of beating him.

rows.name: Bartholomew Kuma
rows.place: One of the Seven Warlords, user of the Paw Pad Fruit. The paw pads on his palms can knock away anything they touch, and the air bombs he compresses between his palms are devastating, especially against characters standing in a row.

rows.name: Portgas D. Ace
rows.place: Second division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates and user of the Flame-Flame Fruit. A powerful fighter who controls fire freely and excels at area attacks, he can easily kill several characters at once.

rows.name: Kizaru
rows.place: A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Glint-Glint Fruit. The Marines' strongest force, yet very laid-back, he excels at kicks and swordplay. Be ready for a Speed-of-Light Kick before you challenge him!

rows.name: Akainu
rows.place: A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Magma Fruit. Stern and upright, he upholds Absolute Justice and won't tolerate the slightest trace of "evil". He can turn his body into searing magma with tremendous power; his Great Eruption can instantly evaporate ice dozens of times bigger than a giant.

rows.name: Rob Lucci
rows.place: A senior World Government CP9 agent who ate the Zoan Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Leopard. The strongest member in CP9's 800-year history.

rows.name: Garp
rows.place: A legendary Marine Vice Admiral, the man who drove Pirate King Roger to the brink. No defense holds up against his Haki-clad fists. He's also extremely carefree and may suddenly fall asleep mid-battle, but don't underestimate his strength because of it!

rows.name: Gecko Moria
rows.place: A shadow-manipulating Devil Fruit user and ruler of Thriller Bark! One of the Seven Warlords, said to have once been a match for Kaido of the "Four Emperors".

rows.name: Eustass Kid
rows.place: A former Supernova who landed on the Sabaody Archipelago along with Luffy and Zoro. Known for his cruelty, he ruthlessly eliminates anyone in his way.

rows.name: Sentomaru
rows.place: Former head of the Marine HQ Science Unit. He leads the "Pacifista" and calls himself the "World's Tightest-Lipped Man"!!
